items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: The transcript only shows the interviewer introducing themselves as Pam Tyler. The interviewee (Jeff Riddick) does not speak or respond in the provided context.

ctx.x: I see. Is it picking my voice up? Oh, good. Then I can tell my name. Dick Allen. I guess you should tell yours if it picks you up.
I don't know if it picks me up. Yes, it does. Yeah. Oh, this is Pam Tyler.
Okay. Good. Well, it seems, everything seems to be working. Good.
